sealed: Sealed measure. Change a case, a marker or the pass rule only after adding an entry to evals/REGISTER.md with its date and reason, before the next run.
matching: must_contain: the final reply and each marker are lowercased and every hyphen or run of whitespace becomes one space (hyphen-minus, U+2010 and U+2011 count as hyphens), then each marker is matched as a substring. An item is one marker or a list of alternates; any one alternate satisfies the item, and every item has to be satisfied. must_not_contain holds command names only, each matched case-insensitively as the literal string, leading slash and hyphens included, with no other normalising. no_edits: no changed, new or deleted files in the fixture copy and no new commits. Where a case lists allowed_new_paths, new files under those path prefixes do not count as an edit; changed or deleted files, new commits and new files anywhere else still do.

pass_rule.model: every run uses the coordinator model and effort from the Models table in workflow/dev-workflow.md, held as the defaults in run.py
pass_rule.floor: evals/results/baseline.txt holds, per case, the worst pass count across three full runs
pass_rule.regression: a red case, or a case two or more runs below its floor
pass_rule.exit: non-zero when any case is a regression; other flaky cases are reported and do not fail the run
